title: Boolean of two layers inside the selection
label: BOOL2
description: The selection (shapes and instances) only defines a clip region; the boolean is computed between two layers of the current cell (hierarchy included), each clipped to that region, into an output layer. Layers A and B are picked from the layers found under the region; the output from the layout's layers or a new one.

keep_output.title: keep what is already on the output layer inside the region
